description: This PHP file defines the LeaveRequestCommentService class within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin. It manages access to LeaveRequestCommentDao objects, providing a getter method that ensures a singleton instance of the DAO. The class acts as a service layer component, facilitating interactions between higher-level application logic and data access objects related to leave request comments.

classes.name: LeaveRequestCommentService
classes.description: Service layer class providing access to LeaveRequestCommentDao for managing leave request comments.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestCommentDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of LeaveRequestCommentDao, creating it if it does not already exist.
